# MaximumPixel Creative Video Studio
> Jaipur's dedicated creative video studio specializing in on-location Video Shoots, Viral Video Editing, and Turnkey Shoot + Edit productions for cafes, restaurants, fashion brands, and creators.

## Overview
MaximumPixel is a specialized video production and post-production studio based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Founded by Krishna Rajak, Vishwajeet Barman, and Rahul Gyanchandani, the studio creates high-retention 4K mobile cinematography, commercial films, and short-form vertical video content tailored for algorithmic reach on Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.

## Core Services & Pricing
- **Video Shoot (On-Location Filming)**: 4K cinema-grade mobile cinematography with gimbal stabilization, multi-angle rigging, and dedicated creative direction in Jaipur starting from ₹1,499.
- **Video Editing (Post-Production)**: High-retention short-form vertical editing, kinetic typography/subtitles, sound design (SFX & foley), velocity speed-ramping, and cinematic color grading starting from ₹499.
- **Turnkey Shoot + Edit Bundles**: End-to-end video solution combining full on-location filming sessions in Jaipur with complete post-production editing starting from ₹2,499.
